Accomplishment
1. Chief Scientific Officer and Enterprise Vice-President, Nemours Children’s Health Care System

2. Internationally Recognized Researcher in Reproductive, Pediatric endocrinology & environmental health, active NIH funded researcher 1990-

3. Member, Scientific Advisory Council, National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences (NIH) 2010-2014

4. Recognized Pediatric Health Care System with two independent children’s hospitals 2018-

5. Best Doctors of America 2005-2018 &Top Pediatricians in America 2012-2017

8. Physician-in-Chief, Nemours AI duPont Hospital for Children and Professor of Pediatrics, Sidney Kimmel Medical College, Jefferson Univ. 2018-
